result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. Only IBM’s cap is increased to the greater of USD 1,000,000 and 12 months’ paid or payable fees; Customer’s separate cap remains the greater of USD 100,000 and fees paid, so the cap is not mutual. The carve-outs are inserted only into IBM’s limitation paragraph and do not clearly apply to Customer’s separate cap, and the preferred IP-infringement carve-out is absent. The express exclusion for loss of or damage to Customer data remains despite the margin comment. The consequential-damages exclusion is mutual, and the payment exception effectively leaves payment obligations outside the limitations, but those points do not cure the cap and carve-out defects. The edits are targeted and preserve unrelated intent, but the inconsistent structure and ambiguous reference to 'a party’s' obligations reduce drafting quality.
